resources.title: Boosting Tuning Checklist
resources.description: A compiled tuning procedure for gradient-boosted models: the five-step tuning order (learning rate and tree count, then tree shape, then randomness, then regularization), copy-ready code for xgb.cv and RandomizedSearchCV, and the noise-check that stops you from chasing a 0.001 AUC improvement that isn't real.

resources.title: Forecast Evaluation & Backtest Reference
resources.description: A reusable reference covering MAE, RMSE, MAPE, and MASE (what each measures and when it misleads), plus a drop-in rolling-origin backtest function so no forecasting project ships on a single train/test split again.

resources.title: Model Fairness Audit Checklist
resources.description: A step-by-step fairness audit procedure with a drop-in group_report() function for selection rate, TPR, FPR, and precision by group, the four-fifths-rule caveat, and a documentation template for recording which fairness trade-off was chosen and why.
